digest.component_or_area: plan review gate and ticket composition
propositions: The config key `verify.max_ticket_description_chars` (default 8000) must be read by the save-time warning logic in addition to the existing plan-review guard and completion precheck, ensuring a single source of truth for the cap.

When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be displayed at save time stating the length, the cap, and that claim review will reject the ticket until the description is shortened.
The warning must be emitted via all three surfaces (CLI stderr, library logger, MCP result field) without altering or blocking the write operation.
No warning must be emitted when the gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, or the ticket type is exempt from plan review.
The save-time warning avoids blind admission failures by providing immediate feedback at ticket creation or edit time rather than at review time.
